description: Use this when the person wants to change something on one of their palimpalem websites: texts, titles, photos, sections, new pages ("add a page about …", added to the menu, sitemap and llms.txt), colours and style, contact details, WhatsApp button, SEO title. Requires palimpalem sign-in. Takes the change in plain words, carries it out and says exactly what changed. Changes are saved and visible right away; each one can be undone (also by asking to undo the last change). Does not touch domain, e-mail, payments or the account. Takes 5 to 60 seconds.

request.description: The change in plain words, in any language, e.g. "Change the main title to Fresh bread every morning" or "Add a section with opening hours: Mon-Fri 8-14".

web.description: The website: its name, its palimpalem address or its own domain.

name: editar_web
title: Change my website
